verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing has a dedicated 'Issuing for agents' capability that lets virtual cards be issued and used autonomously by AI agents, with real-time authorization webhooks, spend controls, and risk scoring enabling background/autonomous decisioning without human intervention, plus an official MCP server for agent-driven API interaction. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of this agentic automation actually running in production and more detail on end-to-end autonomous workflow beyond the docs page.
